section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations and conclusions of the present study regarding the threshold hypothesis in creativity research. It highlights the importance of the IQ range in the tested sample, noting that the study used a naturalistic sample of 300 persons with a normal intelligence distribution, including a higher proportion of individuals with IQs above 120. The intelligence test battery was designed to measure 'g' broadly, and the study concludes that intelligence is highly relevant for creative achievement, even at high ability ranges, with the relationship depending on intelligence level and the creativity indicator.
